provenance.note: Generalized Census ZCTAs intersected with the 2024 Seattle incorporated-place boundary. Map envelopes are ZIP vicinity, not postal boundaries. Shared ZIP reports contain Seattle municipal records only.

stateProvenance.method: Positive-area intersection (>1e-8 square degrees); county residuals subtract incorporated places
stateProvenance.limits: Approximate planning geography, not legal postal or permitting boundaries. Tribal/federal authority and local boundary changes require review before activation.
